mr_title: script in svg should be parsed as ScriptData
mr_description: And added support for custom tags as data when in foreign context namespace.

expected_issues.title: Text state can return to itself at EOF for nested foreign data elements
expected_issues.description:
Foreign-content script/data elements now switch the tree builder into the Text insertion mode with markInsertionMode(); when such elements are nested (script inside svg inside a Text-mode element) the saved original state can itself be Text, so at EOF the builder transitions back to Text forever and parsing overflows the stack.

The Text state handles EOF by popping and transitioning to tb.originalState(), then reprocessing the token. markInsertionMode() is now also called while already in a data/text context in foreign content, so originalState() may be Text: the EOF token is reprocessed in Text endlessly (StackOverflowError on crafted or malformed input, e.g. `<svg><script><svg><script>` without closing tags). Untrusted HTML can crash the parser; the Text state must force a way out when the original state is Text.
